_comment: Per-file line cap for hand-written code modules, enforced by the harness (PreToolUse block) and `interlinked verify` (large_files check). `files` grandfathers offenders (repo-relative path -> recorded line count): a listed file may shrink or hold, but the harness blocks any edit that grows it and verify fails it. The list is currently EMPTY — every cappable file is under the cap (the four original offenders were decomposed 2026-05-18). Generated, test, and .d.ts files are exempt. To tighten, ratchet `max_lines` downward (1500 -> 1200 -> 1000); any file that then exceeds it must be added here or decomposed. Policy: src/harness/large-file-policy.ts.
